title: Intrinsic completeness on a single perfect integral chart
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme and S a scheme, g:S→T an immersion, U an object of S_proet, E/Q_l a finite extension, and d its actual lifted integral coefficient datum. Let K belong to D(d.completedRing T). Suppose the restriction of K to the proetale slice over U after g is isomorphic to the restriction of integralConstantDerived T d(P), for a perfect complex P over the lifted valuation ring. Then the ordinary datum pullback of K to U.left is intrinsically derived complete, for every finite generating family of d.ideal and every representative complex with its realization isomorphism. This is a local assertion; it chooses no stratification, proves no constructibility and asserts no reduction bounds. Use the models of [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models] and the completion predicate of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion].

proof.text: Normalize the given slice isomorphism by scalar restriction along the inverse-image coefficient isomorphism. The pro-etale slice equivalence is fully faithful on derived categories. Apply its inverse on isomorphisms and the datum pullback compositor to obtain an isomorphism between the two ordinary datum pullbacks to U.left. This comparison needs no pullback compatibility of constant realization.

proof.text: The morphism U.hom followed by g is a weakly etale morphism followed by an immersion. Preserve completeness of the constant model along it using stratumIntrinsicComplete_preserved. Use eC followed by the ordinary pullback isomorphism as target realization. The resulting intrinsic unit differs from the requested one by an invertible prefix, which can be cancelled.

lean.statement:
theorem integralPerfectChart_complete
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) [IsImmersion g] (U : S.ProEt)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (P : completedConstantDerived (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcIntegralRing l E)))
    (hP : @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcIntegralRing l E) _
      (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) P)
    (e : Nonempty (integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) U K ≅
      integralLocalDerived g (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) U
        ((integralConstantDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj P)))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → PbcIntegralRing l E)
    (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = (pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules U.left
      (pbcAdicCompletion U.left (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) ℤ)
    (eC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ ((pbcIntegralDatum l E).pull (U.hom ≫ g)).obj K) :
    IsDerivedCompleteIntrinsic U.left (pbcIntegralDatum l E) r a ha
      (((pbcIntegralDatum l E).pull (U.hom ≫ g)).obj K) C eC
